question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who sells and arranges cut flowers.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Florist"** refers to a person who sells and arranges cut flowers. (फूलवाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The florist arranged a beautiful bouquet for the wedding.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Florist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Horticulturist **(उद्यान विशेषज्ञ): Someone involved in the science or art of cultivating gardens.

 
 
• **Example:** The horticulturist explained the best methods for growing roses.
 
 
 
• **Botanist **(वनस्पतिशास्त्री): A scientist who studies plants.
 
 
• **Example: **The botanist discovered a new species of plant in the rainforest.
 
 
 
• **Gardener** (माली): A person who tends and cultivates a garden as a pastime or for a living.
 
 
• **Example:** The gardener spends hours every day taking care of the plants.
 
 

31:Tc53,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
